label: PF Backlog 561
title: Delivery lane reconciliation + auto-issue/auto-RCCA on validation FAIL + app_boot checker fix
body:
## Why
IS-PF-0037: lane-driven delivery never self-heals and never escalates. Failure classes: (a) crashed/hung lane
between PR-open and merge/provenance leaves item verifying with an OPEN PR forever; (b) validation FAIL blocks
the item without attaching the failing checks and without raising an issue; (c) app_boot checker builds a module
name from the project dir (product-forge) -> import product-forge.api.app -> SyntaxError (invalid module).

## What
- delivery.reconcile(): remote truth (PR state + origin/develop tip) vs item state; hooks on worker start +
  wg recover + lane exit. MERGED-but-unrecorded -> complete + provenance from remote. OPEN+FAIL -> attach
  failing checks to item + raise issue. verifying with no progress -> event + issue signal.
- FAIL wiring: classification work_failed|gate_failed|flaky; issue raise with checks evidence + backlog_ref;
  auto re-run once for flaky; bounded auto-revision (2 attempts) for auto-mode work_failed; manual always asks.
- app_boot fix: import via importlib path-based (no string-concat module names).
- Scanner: reuse the scheduled tick/dogfood machinery to scan signals (blocked with FAIL, verifying stalled,
  open issues aging) -> events + issues.

## Where
core/delivery.py, core/validation_engine.py, core/pr_gate.py, core/issues.py hooks, scripts/dev check.

## Verify
- unit: reconcile each state (merged-unrecorded, open+fail, verifying-stalled)
- gate: app_boot parses real worktree app; FAIL path raises issue with checks attached
- e2e: re-deliver BI-PF-0394 through the lane (PR #26) to PASS.
